func use(items: [Int], operation: (Int) async -> Void, n: Int) async {
  let cap = min(1, n)
  // ruleid: serial-bounded-helper-swift
  await mapWithConcurrency(items: items, concurrency: 1, operation: operation)
  // ruleid: serial-bounded-helper-swift
  await mapWithConcurrency(items: items, maxConcurrency: 1, operation: operation)
  // ruleid: serial-bounded-helper-swift
  await mapWithConcurrency(items: items, max_concurrency: 1, operation: operation)
  // ok: serial-bounded-helper-swift
  await mapWithConcurrency(items, min(1, n), operation)
  // ok: serial-bounded-helper-swift
  await mapWithConcurrency(items, min(n, 1), operation)
  // ok: serial-bounded-helper-swift
  await mapWithConcurrency(items, cap, operation)
  await mapWithConcurrency(items: items, maxConcurrency: 4, operation: operation)
  await mapWithConcurrency(items: items, concurrency: n, operation: operation)
  await mapWithConcurrency(items, min(4, n), operation)
  await mapWithConcurrency(items, max(1, n), operation)
  await mapWithConcurrency(items, n + 1, operation)
  await mapWithConcurrency(items, min(4, n + 1), operation)
}
